verdict.rationale: Raygun documents smart filters that segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser and custom tags. It also has a search results page and top-level filters that include tags. That covers tag and version/release filtering through UI filters, but there is no evidence of a real query language or of searching across multiple projects. Missing for 10: a documented query syntax, cross-project search, environment and custom-property filtering, and independent corroboration.
